# Graph workflows

Read the [standard](references/standard.md) whenever working with a graph workflow.

- To create or edit one, follow [writing guidance](references/writing.md).
- To read or execute one, follow [execution guidance](references/executing.md).

Use the bundled Python CLI to validate graphs and locate instructions. Agents execute the work; the CLI does not.
